verdict.rationale: pnpm is itself an official, documented CLI (pnpm.io/pnpm-cli). It ships scriptable, automation-friendly commands that agents can drive safely, such as dry-run resolution with no disk writes, offline/store-only installs, auto frozen-lockfile in CI and `pnpm audit --fix`, and community users confirm daily CLI use. Missing for 10: documented machine-readable/structured output or agent-specific guidance (llms.txt and markdown docs return 404), and independent evidence of AI-agent-driven usage.
